verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Orama's search engine capabilities, including the facets API, the AnswerSession API and SDKs. It never mentions official UI component libraries for a search box, results, facets or pagination. The facets API and AnswerSession state callbacks are backend building blocks a developer would use to build the UI, not prebuilt UI components, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, official UI component libraries let me assemble a full search interface — box, results, facets, pagination — without building it from scratch
